note: One Wikimedia Commons image per laureate showing the prize work itself (artifact, apparatus, structure, diagram, publication or place), not a portrait. Licences read from Commons extmetadata; only public domain, CC0, CC BY and CC BY-SA accepted. Each thumbnail was downloaded and checked visually. width/height are the API thumbwidth/thumbheight for iiurlwidth=640; the served thumb_url can be a 960px bucket or the unscaled original, with the same aspect ratio. Where no relevant licensed image was found the laureate is listed under gaps rather than given a loosely related image.

1.file: File:First medical X-ray by Wilhelm Röntgen of his wife Anna Bertha Ludwig's hand - 18951222.jpg
1.caption_he: "יד עם טבעות": צילום הרנטגן של יד אשתו ברתה, 1895
1.caption_en: "Hand mit Ringen": Röntgen's X-ray of his wife Bertha's hand, 1895
1.relation: One of the first X-ray images, made by Röntgen himself in December 1895 weeks after he discovered the rays the prize honours.

6.file: File:Ionisation chamber made by Pierre Curie, c 1895-1900. (9660571297).jpg
6.artist: Science Museum London / Science and Society Picture Library
6.caption_he: תא יינון שבנה פייר קירי למדידת קרינה רדיואקטיבית
6.caption_en: Ionisation chamber built by Pierre Curie to measure radioactivity
6.relation: Instrument of the kind the Curies used to quantify the radiation of uranium and other substances, the measurements behind the 1903 prize on radiation phenomena.

37.caption_he: תרשים רמות אנרגיה של פיזור ראמאן: קווי סטוקס ואנטי-סטוקס לצד פיזור ריילי
37.caption_en: Energy-level diagram of Raman scattering: Stokes and anti-Stokes lines beside Rayleigh scattering
37.relation: A modern generic textbook diagram (not Raman's own figure) of the inelastic light scattering he discovered in 1928.

962.caption_he: סכמת הגברת פולס מצויץ: מתיחה, הגברה ודחיסה (תוויות בצרפתית)
962.caption_en: Chirped pulse amplification scheme: stretch, amplify, compress (French labels)
962.relation: Schematic of the chirped pulse amplification technique itself; a generic diagram, not Strickland's original apparatus.

160.artist: J. H. van 't Hoff; revised by Ernst Cohen; translated by Thomas Ewan
160.caption_he: דף השער של "מחקרים בדינמיקה כימית", מהדורה אנגלית 1896
160.caption_en: Title page of 'Studies in Chemical Dynamics', English edition 1896
160.relation: English edition of van 't Hoff's Études de dynamique chimique (1884), the work on chemical dynamics cited by the prize; page 9 of the scanned book.

230.file: File:Model of the Structure of Penicillin, by Dorothy Hodgkin, Oxford, c.1945.jpeg
230.artist: Museum of the History of Science, University of Oxford
230.caption_he: מודל צפיפות אלקטרונים של פניצילין, מעבודת הודג'קין
230.caption_en: Electron-density contour model of penicillin from Hodgkin's work
230.relation: Three-dimensional electron-density map of penicillin built from the X-ray crystallography by Hodgkin and colleagues that the prize recognises.

292.caption_he: סכמת ניסוי משאבה-גשוש בפולסי אור קצרים
292.caption_en: Schematic of a pump–probe experiment with short light pulses
292.relation: Generic schematic of the pump–probe principle that Zewail's femtosecond spectroscopy used to watch transition states; not his own apparatus.

1055.caption_he: מבנה הגביש של MOF-5: צמתי אבץ מחוברים במקשרים אורגניים
1055.caption_en: Crystal structure of MOF-5: zinc clusters joined by organic linkers
1055.relation: MOF-5, the framework reported by Yaghi's group in 1999, is a canonical example of the metal–organic frameworks cited by the prize; rendering is a modern illustration.

299.file: File:Cajal - a purkinje neuron from the human cerebellum.jpg
299.caption_he: ציור יד של קחאל: תא פורקיניה מהמוח הקטן של האדם
299.caption_en: Cajal's drawing of a Purkinje neuron from the human cerebellum
299.relation: Original drawing by Cajal (Museo Cajal, Madrid) of the nerve-cell structure his prize-winning work described.

428.caption_he: גרגירי תירס בדגם פסיפס מתנועת היסודות Ac/Ds
428.caption_en: Maize kernels with mosaic colour caused by Ac/Ds movement
428.relation: McClintock's own figure showing how Ac/Ds mobile elements produce variegated kernel colour, the evidence for mobile genetic elements.

918.caption_he: לענה חד-שנתית (Artemisia annua), הצמח שממנו הופק ארטמיסינין
918.caption_en: Sweet wormwood (Artemisia annua), the plant source of artemisinin
918.relation: The plant from which Tu Youyou's team extracted artemisinin; photographed in Germany, not at her laboratory.

1024.caption_en: Uridine versus pseudouridine: the nucleoside modification
1024.relation: Shows the uridine-to-pseudouridine substitution, the kind of nucleoside modification Karikó and Weissman found lets mRNA avoid an inflammatory response.

719.caption_he: מפת העולם לפי מדד הפיתוח האנושי (HDI), 2021
719.caption_en: World map of countries by Human Development Index (HDI), 2021
719.relation: The HDI, launched by the UNDP in 1990 with Sen's involvement, builds on his capability approach; the map shows the index, not his welfare-economics theory itself.

846.caption_he: טרבל שבוואלה מהאוויר: כפר הררי ומרעה אלפיני
846.caption_en: Aerial view of Törbel, Valais: a mountain village and alpine pastures
846.relation: Törbel's communally owned alpine meadows and forests, governed by village rules since 1483, are a central case of long-lived common-pool resource management in Ostrom's 'Governing the Commons' (1990); the photo shows the place, not her analysis.

1034.file: File:Long-run perspective on female labor force participation rates, OWID.svg
1034.caption_he: שיעור ההשתתפות של נשים בכוח העבודה, 1890 עד 2016, בשש מדינות
1034.caption_en: Female labour force participation rates, 1890 to 2016, six countries
1034.relation: An Our World in Data chart of the long-run rise in women's labour force participation, the history Goldin reconstructed; it is not her own figure and does not show her U-shaped curve.

462.caption_he: "זיכרון מסולפרינו" מאת דונאן, מהדורה ראשונה, ג'נבה 1862
462.caption_en: Dunant's 'Un Souvenir de Solferino', first edition, Geneva 1862
462.relation: Dunant's book on the wounded at Solferino, which led to the founding of the Red Cross; copy held by the ICRC Library.

496.relation: The Chicago settlement house Jane Addams co-founded in 1889 and ran, the base of her social and peace work.

809.caption_he: בניין המטה של בנק גראמין, מירפור, דאקה
809.caption_en: Grameen Bank headquarters building, Mirpur, Dhaka
809.relation: Headquarters of the Grameen Bank, the microcredit institution Yunus founded and shared the prize with.

579.caption_he: נילס הולגרסון על חומת האבנים מול האווזים בחווה, איור של ג'ון באואר מהמהדורה הראשונה
579.caption_en: Nils Holgersson on the stone wall facing the farm geese, John Bauer's illustration from the first edition
579.relation: An illustration from the first volume of 'Nils Holgerssons underbara resa genom Sverige' (1906), the geography book cited among Lagerlöf's works.

583.caption_he: שער 'גיתנג'לי (מנחות שיר)', מקמילן, לונדון, 1913, עם מבוא מאת ייטס
583.caption_en: Title page of 'Gitanjali (Song Offerings)', Macmillan, London, 1913, introduced by W. B. Yeats
583.relation: The English Gitanjali, Tagore's own prose translations, was the book that brought him the 1913 prize.

639.relation: The house where Agnon lived and wrote from 1931 until his death; his books are under copyright, so this shows the place of writing, not the work.

1042.caption_he: קברים בבית הקברות הלאומי ל-18 במאי בגוואנגג'ו
1042.caption_en: Graves at the May 18th National Cemetery, Gwangju
1042.relation: Resting place of victims of the 1980 Gwangju Uprising, the subject of Han Kang's 'Human Acts'; her books are under copyright, so this shows the history, not the work.

26.caption_he: תוכן העניינים של Annalen der Physik, יוני 1905, ובו מאמר הקוונטים של האור של איינשטיין (מס' 6)
26.caption_en: Table of contents of Annalen der Physik, June 1905, listing Einstein's light-quantum paper (item 6)
26.relation: The issue that published Einstein's 'heuristic viewpoint' paper explaining the photoelectric effect, the work cited for his 1921 prize.

27.caption_he: מודל בוהר של האטום: אלקטרון קופץ בין מסלולים ופולט פוטון ΔE = hν
27.caption_en: Bohr model of the atom: an electron jumps between orbits and emits a photon, ΔE = hν
27.relation: A modern generic diagram of Bohr's 1913 atomic model, the structure of atoms and their radiation honoured in 1922.

217.caption_he: סליל אלפא: מבנה משני של חלבון, באיור סרט
217.caption_en: Alpha helix: a protein secondary structure drawn as a ribbon
217.relation: A generic modern rendering of the alpha helix that Pauling, Corey and Branson proposed in 1951 from chemical-bond geometry; not Pauling's own model.

222.caption_he: רצף חומצות האמינו של אינסולין בקר: שרשרת A ושרשרת B וגשרי הדיסולפיד
222.caption_en: Amino-acid sequence of bovine insulin: A and B chains with disulfide bridges
222.relation: A modern redrawing of the sequence Sanger determined for bovine insulin (completed 1955), the work of his 1958 prize.

339.file: File:Sample of penicillin mould presented by Alexander Fleming to Douglas Macleod, 1935 (9672239344).jpg
339.artist: Science Museum London / Science and Society Picture Library
339.caption_he: דגימת עובש פניציליום בקופסת פליז, מתנה מפרופסור אלכסנדר פלמינג, 1935
339.caption_en: Sample of penicillium mould in a brass case, presented by Alexander Fleming, 1935
339.relation: A culture of the mould in which Fleming discovered penicillin in 1928, given by Fleming himself; held by the Science Museum, London.

372.file: File:Template from Crick and Watson’s DNA molecular model, 1953. (9660573227).jpg
372.artist: Science Museum, London / Science and Society Picture Library
372.caption_he: תבנית אלומיניום של בסיס מתוך מודל ה-DNA של קריק ווטסון, 1953
372.caption_en: Aluminium base template from Crick and Watson's 1953 DNA model
372.relation: An original component of the 1953 double-helix model at the Science Museum, London, the structure for which Crick shared the 1962 prize.

679.file: File:The competitive price system adapted from Samuelson, 1961.jpg
679.artist: Lorie A. Wagner, Daniel E. Sullivan, and John L. Sznopek
679.caption_he: מערכת המחירים התחרותית: זרימות בין משקי בית לעסקים בשוקי מוצרים וגורמי ייצור
679.caption_en: The competitive price system: flows between households and business in goods and factor markets
679.relation: A 1997 US Geological Survey redrawing adapted from Samuelson's textbook 'Economics' (1961 edition); it shows his teaching framework, not the mathematical theory cited in his prize.

759.caption_he: פונקציית הערך של תורת הסיכוי: הפסד כואב יותר מרווח באותו גודל
759.caption_en: Prospect theory value function: a loss weighs more than an equal gain
759.relation: A recently drawn generic plot (parameters from Tversky and Kahneman 1992) of the value function at the core of the prospect theory cited in Kahneman's prize.

524.caption_he: ההמון סביב בריכת ההשתקפות בצעדה לוושינגטון, 28 באוגוסט 1963
524.caption_en: Crowds around the Reflecting Pool at the March on Washington, 28 August 1963
524.relation: The march where King gave the 'I Have a Dream' speech, the high point of the non-violent civil-rights campaign recognised by his 1964 prize.

555.file: File:B-Section courtyard, Maximum Security Prison, Robben Island (01).jpg
555.caption_he: חצר אגף B בכלא הביטחוני ברובן איילנד, שבו היה מנדלה כלוא
555.caption_en: Courtyard of B-Section, Robben Island maximum security prison, where Mandela was held
555.relation: Mandela spent 18 of his 27 prison years on Robben Island; the place of the imprisonment that preceded the negotiated end of apartheid honoured in 1993.

659.caption_he: תחנת הרכבת של אראקטקה, עיר הולדתו של גרסיה מרקס
659.caption_en: Train station of Aracataca, García Márquez's birthplace
659.relation: Aracataca is widely regarded as the model for Macondo, and its railway appears in his fiction; the novels themselves are under copyright, so this shows the place, not the work.

gaps.678: נמצאו ב-Commons רק דיוקנאות של יאן טינברגן; רוב הקבצים בשם 'Tinbergen' עוסקים בניקו טינברגן, חוקר ההתנהגות. לא נמצא תרשים חופשי של המודלים האקונומטריים שלו.
gaps.783: לא נמצא צילום ברישיון מותר של נטיעות 'התנועה לחגורה הירוקה'. בחוברת של אונסק"ו (CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO) מופיע איור דיוקן שלה, ולא העבודה עצמה.
gaps.670: ספריה של טוני מוריסון מוגנים בזכויות יוצרים, ולא נמצאה ב-Commons תמונה חופשית שקשורה ישירות ליצירתה.
